title: U.S. Visa Interview
goal: answer the officer's probing questions without contradicting your own story
key_phrases: the purpose of my trip is

title: Hotel Check-In
setting: a hotel front desk in the evening
goal: check in and sort out the mix-up with the room

title: Asking for Directions
setting: a street in an unfamiliar city
goal: get to the station, asking for a repeat when you miss something

title: Ordering Coffee
setting: a busy coffee shop at rush hour
goal: order a drink and something with it, keeping the queue moving
key_phrases: for here or to take away

title: The Job Interview
goal: describe yourself and ask one real question at the end
key_phrases: could you tell me about the team

title: Setting Up the Apartment
goal: describe an object whose English name you don't know
key_phrases: it's a thing you use for

title: At the Doctor's Office
goal: describe symptoms precisely and answer follow-up questions
key_phrases: I've had a sore throat since

title: Emergency Call
learner_role: caller who doesn't know the address
goal: describe your location without an address and get help sent

title: The Neighbour Downstairs
goal: admit what is fair, push back on the rest, agree on quiet hours
key_phrases: after ten I'll keep it quiet

title: The Boy By The Fountain
learner_role: adult who found a lost boy
goal: describe the child: age, clothes, hair

title: Two Tickets, Please
setting: a museum ticket desk before closing
goal: buy two tickets and ask about closing time

title: A Jacket For Monday
goal: compare three jackets and choose one for an interview
key_phrases: do you have a bigger size

title: The Shop Before Dinner
setting: a small corner shop with goods behind the counter
goal: buy food by naming quantity and weight, with no pointing

title: Two Centimetres, No More
buddy_role: barber who cuts faster than he listens
goal: state the length as a number and stop the barber in time
key_phrases: a little shorter on the sides

title: The Melon Stall
setting: a fruit stall at a market
goal: pick fruit, ask which is sweeter, and haggle the price down

title: The Night Window
goal: explain the symptom and get a substitute medicine

title: The Ticket Window
goal: work out the connection and buy the right ticket

title: The Card That Vanished
setting: a phone call to your bank
goal: block the card and dispute three payments you didn't make
key_phrases: I need to block my card

title: What Do You Do All Day
goal: explain your job with no jargon at all
key_phrases: my job is to make sure

title: The Room With No Window
setting: a hotel front desk, late evening
goal: get the room changed or compensated, staying polite

title: Passport Control At Heathrow
learner_role: arriving traveller with no hotel booking
goal: account for all nine days coherently

title: The Report Number
goal: get the word 'stolen' into the report and obtain a reference number
key_phrases: could you put that in the report

title: The Long Way Round
setting: the end of a taxi ride at night
buddy_role: taxi driver who took a detour
goal: challenge the route and agree a fair fare
key_phrases: I'll pay what it should be

title: The Empty Chair
setting: a phone call the day after
learner_role: the person who didn't show up
goal: apologise for the specific thing and repair it
key_phrases: let me make it up to you

title: The Brake Job Invoice
goal: take the invoice apart line by line and get the extras removed
key_phrases: I'd like that removed from the invoice

title: The Essay Extension
buddy_role: teacher who has heard every excuse
goal: get an extension by giving a credible reason and a real date
key_phrases: I'd like to ask for an extension
I can have it in by

title: The Balcony At Ainur's
setting: a balcony at a party where you know nobody
goal: start and hold small talk without turning it into an interview

title: Saying No To The Offer
setting: a phone call with a hiring manager
buddy_role: hiring manager who pushes back once
goal: say no clearly without burning the bridge
key_phrases: I'd love to stay in touch
